description:
Join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD, as an SDC/Infection Control Nurse. This urgent full-time opportunity offers a vital role in ensuring both staff excellence and patient safety within our compassionate environment. We are actively seeking a dedicated professional to join our team by June 30th.

In this dual-focused position, you will be responsible for coordinating staff development programs, including orientation and in-service education, to enhance clinical competencies. Concurrently, you will lead our infection control initiatives, developing and implementing policies, conducting surveillance, and educating staff on best practices to prevent and manage infections.

We offer a competitive hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00, based on your experience. If you are a Registered Nurse with a passion for education and a commitment to maintaining the highest standards of health and safety, we encourage you to apply today.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license
Experience in staff development or clinical education
Experience in infection control practices within a healthcare setting
Knowledge of state and federal regulations for long-term care facilities
Strong communication and organizational skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00, based on experience.

description: We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Marketing Director to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Sarasota County, FL. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to a recently acquired facility, playing a pivotal role in its growth and success. We are looking for a proactive and results-driven individual who can make a significant impact.The ideal candidate will be a highly presentable and driven professional, eager to engage with the community and drive census growth. This role requires a commitment to working occasional weekends to meet business needs and foster strong relationships.This position offers competitive compensation for the right individual, reflecting the importance of this leadership role within our organization. If you are a 'hustler' with a passion for healthcare marketing, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as a Marketing Director, preferably in a skilled nursing or healthcare environment.
Demonstrated ability to work occasional weekends.
Exceptional presentation skills and professional demeanor.
Proven track record of being proactive, results-oriented, and highly driven.
Strong understanding of healthcare marketing strategies and community relations.

description: Are you a dedicated Speech Language Pathologist seeking a flexible PRN opportunity? A premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL, is urgently seeking a skilled SLP to join their critical care team. This role offers a competitive hourly rate and the chance to make a significant impact on patient recovery.This is a critical opening, and we are looking for a professional who is passionate about providing high-quality speech and language therapy services. You will work with a diverse patient population, helping them regain communication and swallowing abilities. This position comes with an attractive sign-on or relocation bonus, making it an excellent opportunity for both local and relocating candidates.Join a supportive environment where your expertise is valued, and contribute to a team dedicated to patient well-being and rehabilitation success. Apply today to learn more about this urgent opening.
requirements: Master's degree in Speech-Language Pathology
Current state licensure as a Speech Language Pathologist in Florida
Certificate of Clinical Competence (CCC) from ASHA
Previous experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
Ability to work on a PRN basis
salaryOrBonusInfo: $38 - $49/hr with a $5K Sign on or relocation bonus.

description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated Full-time Occupational Therapist to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Ocala, FL. This critical role offers a unique opportunity to provide essential therapy services, helping patients regain independence and improve their quality of life within a supportive and dynamic environment.

As an Occupational Therapist, you will be instrumental in developing and implementing individualized treatment plans, collaborating with a multidisciplinary team to achieve optimal patient outcomes. This position offers a competitive hourly rate and the chance to make a significant impact on patient recovery and well-being.
requirements: Current state licensure as an Occupational Therapist (OT)
Master's or Doctorate degree in Occupational Therapy from an accredited program
Prior experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting is highly preferred
Strong clinical assessment and treatment planning skills
Ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rate of $40.00 - $48.00, based on experience.
